articles.title: Junior Caminero adopts familiar troll after Rays sweep New York: 'Theeee Yankees lose!'
articles.description: Caminero, whose Rays swept New York 3-0 in the ALDS, also did Stephen Curry's iconic "night night" celebration at Yankee Stadium.

articles.title: Yankees can't grab a game as they're swept away by Rays in disappointing ALDS
articles.description: An overturned homer loomed large as the Rays, perhaps the most complete team remaining, ended their rival's season in sweeping fashion.

articles.title: How rare were Michael King's start-save combo, Dodgers-Braves homers, Yankees' error-fest?

articles.title: Yankees considering lineup changes for Game 3. How can they jump-start the offense?
